relations.subject: Lionel David Barnett
relations.evidence: Barnett was educated at Liverpool High School, Liverpool Institute, University College, Liverpool and Trinity College, Cambridge

relations.subject: Lionel David Barnett
relations.evidence: Trinity College, Cambridge, where he took a first class degree in classics

relations.subject: Lionel David Barnett
relations.role: Assistant Keeper in the Department of Oriental Printed Books and Manuscripts
relations.evidence: In 1899, he joined the British Museum as Assistant Keeper in the Department of Oriental Printed Books and Manuscripts.

relations.subject: Lionel David Barnett
relations.evidence: In 1908 he became Keeper, remaining in the post until his retirement in 1936.

relations.subject: Lionel David Barnett
relations.evidence: He was also Professor of Sanskrit at University College, London from 1906 to 1917

relations.subject: Lionel David Barnett
relations.evidence: founding Lecturer in Sanskrit at the School of Oriental Studies (1917–1948)

relations.subject: Lionel David Barnett
relations.role: Lecturer in Ancient Indian History and Epigraphy
relations.evidence: Lecturer in Ancient Indian History and Epigraphy (1922–1948)

relations.subject: Lionel David Barnett
relations.evidence: In 1948, at the age of 77, he rejoined the British Museum, which was desperately short of staff, as an Assistant Keeper, remaining there until his death.
